results_160_new_tokens_ARM_D.reading: NOT a truncation artifact. A larger budget does not rescue ARM D.

AN_OVERCLAIM_I_MADE_AND_RETRACTED: On the France prompt alone ARM D answered correctly and I said the zero-byte repair WORKS. It does not generalize: 1 of 6 prompts. The claim was made on a single sample and is withdrawn. Recorded because this program's failures are usually exactly this shape -- a real effect at one point promoted to a rule.
what_this_ESTABLISHES: CAPABILITY-DEAD IS REFUTED and stays refuted. The body emits correct, formatted answers ('The capital of France is **Paris**.') and coherent reasoning ('The user is asking me to name three primary colors. This is a simple question about color theory.'). A dead body does not do that.
The 0/43 is NOT a pure capability measurement: it was taken entirely on ARM A, where this body reasons but does not emit </think> within budget and so never reaches answer space.
ARM A is not silent. It REASONS. The earlier ' <think>'-and-stop reading came from the binary's own template path, not from ARM A as rendered here.
what_this_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: That a template change repairs the body. It does not -- ARM D succeeds on 1 of 6.
A capability score under any arm. The 43-case suite has NOT been re-run on ARM D or E.
That the failure is purely a state transition. ARM D starts in answer space and STILL returns empty or re-opens <think> on most prompts, which points at the body as well.
Arithmetic competence: ARM A read '17 + 25' back as '17 + 2'.
next_experiment: run the full 43-case suite on ARM D and ARM E and compare against the 0/43 taken on ARM A. That converts this from a refutation into a number.
claim_boundary: Greedy, single sample per cell, 6 prompts, 40 and 160 new tokens. Not a capability suite.
Arms hand-rendered through --raw-prompt so the template is controlled exactly; this is NOT the binary's own template path, which behaves differently and is recorded separately.
Machine contended by the ModelLake fill throughout.
